{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "Characterizing and triaging incidents by their nature (type, severity, likely root cause, and recurrence) to identify what warrants attention",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "incident_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Classifies the substantive nature of each incident from its description -- a core facet of what the incident is about."},
    {"name": "severity_indicator", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures impact level (outage vs degraded vs blocked access), directly relevant to prioritizing attention."},
    {"name": "root_cause_hint", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Infers likely causal layer, adding an explanatory facet to the incident characterization."},
    {"name": "temporal_recurrence", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Distinguishes recurring vs isolated issues, a strong signal for what is worth attention."},
    {"name": "assignment_consistency", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "A process/ops quality flag about assignment, orthogonal to characterizing the incident content itself."},
    {"name": "assigned_to_technician", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Largely restates the existing assigned_to field; a routing attribute, not a facet of incident nature."},
    {"name": "caller_category", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Describes who reported the incident (human vs automation), tangential to the incident's substance and severity."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.68,
  "structure_quality": 0.72,
  "focus_actionability": 0.8,
  "rationale": "A clear plurality of columns (incident_type, severity_indicator, root_cause_hint, temporal_recurrence) coherently centre on a single inferable focus: characterizing incidents by their nature and impact to surface what deserves attention. These form a genuine multi-facet analytical structure (type / severity / cause / recurrence) at a useful granularity, and the focus is highly actionable for triage. However, coherence is diluted by three columns that drift onto adjacent, non-incident-nature themes (process assignment quality, technician identity that duplicates existing data, and caller provenance). This scatter across ops-hygiene and routing dimensions keeps the set from being a tightly unified focus, and one column is largely a restatement of an existing field, so structure and coherence fall short of full marks."
}
